section-2.h1:
Lift. Sweat.
Go home.
Come back tomorrow.
section-2.lede: A proper neighbourhood gym. Free weights, machines, cardio, Zumba and yoga in the evening, trainers who learn your name. Open from 5:30 in the morning, six days a week.

photo.alt: A young man doing a dumbbell curl in front of the dumbbell rack
A man flipping a large tractor tyre on the gym floor

photo2.alt: A man holding a barbell front squat at the bottom

about.h2:
A para gym,
not a mall gym.

items.p: Iron Para Gym opened in 2016 on the ground floor of a house in Jodhpur Park. The owner, Subrata Ghosh, still runs the morning shift himself.
It is one big room. Free weights on one side, machines and cardio on the other, a mat area at the back for classes and stretching. There is a fan over every rack and an AC that works in summer.

items.li: Plates up to 20 kg, dumbbells to 40 kg. Two squat racks, a flat and incline bench, a Smith machine.
Trainers on the floor, not at the desk. Ask anyone in a black T-shirt for help with form.
No sales pressure. Plans are on this page. Pay for the month you want, nothing more.
Women's hour 11 am to 1 pm. Women only on the floor, Monday to Saturday.

facilities.h2: Everything you need. Nothing you'll pay for and never use.
facilities.lede: All of this is included in every membership. Group classes too.

photo.alt: A man doing preacher curls on a red bench

facilities.p: Two squat racks, flat and incline benches, a deadlift platform, dumbbells from 2.5 to 40 kg.

photo2.alt: A man doing triceps pushdowns on a cable machine

facilities.p2: Cable crossover, lat pulldown, leg press, leg curl and extension, chest press, Smith machine.
facilities.p3: Four treadmills, two cross-trainers, two bikes, a rower, battle ropes, kettlebells and a tyre.

photo4.alt: A group sitting cross-legged on yoga mats on a lawn

facilities.p4: Zumba, yoga, HIIT and a Sunday stretch class on the mat area. Timetable below. Included.

photo5.alt: A trainer correcting a woman's posture in a standing stretch

facilities.p5: One trainer, one plan written for you, twelve sessions a month. Booked in advance so you get the slot you want.
facilities.p6: Separate changing rooms for men and women, 40 day-lockers (bring your own lock), a shower, filtered drinking water, first-aid box at the desk.
facilities.facilities-note: We do not have a steam room, a pool or a juice bar. We keep the fees low instead.

classes.lede: Classes run on the mat area at the back. Come five minutes early. All of them are included in every plan; no extra booking, just turn up.

photo.alt: Two women seated in a yoga pose with arms raised

classes.p: "I joined for the 6 am HIIT class and stayed for the people. Nobody stares, nobody sells you anything."
classes.table-note: Zumba is taken by a visiting instructor. If she is on leave the slot becomes an open mat hour. We post changes on the noticeboard and on WhatsApp.

plans.h2: Three plans. The price is the price.
plans.lede: Every plan covers the whole gym and every class. Pay cash, UPI or card at the desk. There is a one-time admission fee of ₹500 on your first plan.
plans.plans-note: Students with a valid college ID get ₹100 off the monthly plan. No refunds once a plan has started, but you can freeze it as shown above. Prices are examples for this sample site.

items.p: 12 one-hour sessions a month with one trainer. Added on top of any plan.
One visit, full gym, any class running that day. Your first visit is free.

timings.td14: Durga Pujo (Ashtami to Dashami), Kali Pujo, Holi, 15 August, 26 January
timings.table-note: Last entry is 45 minutes before closing. The busiest hours are 6 to 8 in the morning and 6 to 9 in the evening.

trainers.h2: Three people who know the floor
trainers.lede: All three are certified fitness trainers and first-aid trained. One of them is on the floor at every hour we are open.

photo.alt: Arjun, a young man in an olive T-shirt standing in the gym

items.p2: Runs the morning shift. Teaches the squat, bench and deadlift from scratch and writes most of the beginner plans.

photo.alt: Rohit, a young man in a red vest smiling next to a punching bag

items.p2: Takes the 6 am circuit class and the evening floor. Kettlebells, ropes, boxing basics on the bag, and conditioning for school and college athletes.

photo.alt: Priya, a woman holding a dumbbell in the gym

items.p2: Runs the women's hour and the morning yoga class. Works with beginners, new mothers and anyone coming back after a long gap.

items.p: No appointment. Your first visit is free. Say you are new at the desk.
We ask what you want, check for old injuries, measure height, weight and waist.

items.h3: A tour and a first workout
items.p: The trainer shows you every machine and walks you through a light first session.
Pay at the desk if you want to continue. Nobody will call you if you don't.

items.li: Indoor shoes. Outdoor shoes stay in the rack at the door.
A towel and a water bottle. We have filtered water, not disposable cups.
A lock for the day-locker. Lockers are emptied at closing.
Re-rack your plates and wipe the bench after use.
Phone calls off the floor, please. Photos are fine if nobody else is in them.
Tell a trainer about any injury, heart condition or pregnancy before starting.
Children under 14 are not allowed on the floor.
